title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Pie Chart on Time Spent on Listening Activities
prompt: The pie chart below shows the percentage of time spent on different listening activities by a group of adult learners during a 10-week English course. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先仔细观察饼图，识别各类听力活动所占比例，并注意比较主要特征。写作时请用至少150词总结图表信息，不要加入个人观点或原因分析。
